item.title: Version 0.4.1.6 (2626) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.6 (Build 2626)

Variator 0.4.1.6: two variations per video, hooks erased for their full time, Thai hooks read, clearer render errors and a hook preview that matches the export.

Two variations per video.

Create now makes two variations of each video instead of three, so a batch finishes sooner.

A hook is erased until its text leaves.

A detected hook stays erased for as long as its text is on screen, also on two-line hooks.

Quick keeps the hook window on short clips.

On single-take clips and after an early first cut, Quick now places the hook in the same window as Localization.

A refused render says why.

When a render cannot run, the app now shows its real reason instead of a generic error.

Scene settings survive a new analysis.

After a new analysis or an undo, per-scene settings drop only the scenes that no longer exist.

The hook preview matches the export size.

The hook preview now uses the same minimum size and per-line word limit as the finished video.

Replace with Original keeps the source style.

Replace with the Original style keeps the look of the source hook, and an unclean erase keeps its cover.

Emoji are never invented.

A colour blob is never drawn as a made-up emoji, and emoji no longer shorten the hook collage.

Thai hooks are read.

Burned Thai hooks are now read by text recognition, so they can be replaced or translated.

Mixed-script hooks get their full time.

A one-line hook that mixes scripts now keeps its real on-screen time.

Remove after Localization matches the editor.

Remove after Localization renders the same clean plate that the editor shows.

A stuck render retries once.

If the Engine stops making progress, it retries once and then shows a clear error, without a second renderer.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.5 (2569) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.5 (Build 2569)

Variator 0.4.1.5: Remove works over faces, long hooks keep their plate and collage, items follow the speed, and the final video always renders on the Engine.

Remove anyway erases the hook over a face.

After the face warning, Remove anyway now really erases the burned hook, also where it crosses a face.

Long hooks keep their plate and collage.

A burned hook that stays on screen longer than 7 s keeps the Replace plate and the Hook Collage for its whole length.

Stickers and text follow the speed.

With a speed change in Quick, every canvas item starts and ends at the right moment of the finished video.

The final video always renders on the Engine.

An emoji sticker or a silent clip with pitch no longer sends the final video to the fallback renderer.

A market dub speaks the market language.

Dubbing for a target market always uses that market's language, and a skipped dub is shown with its reason.

The hook follows the right video.

Switching the source video refreshes the measured hook, so items never inherit the hook of the previous clip.

Bundled fonts are listed correctly.

TikTok Sans appears under Bundled with Variator, and colour-emoji Latin fonts are no longer marked as broken.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.4 (2568) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.4 (Build 2568)

Variator 0.4.1.4 RC 2: banner, collage and plate end on the hook's last frame, the Studio plate always reaches the export, localization always gives an export, and links import from any folder.

Banner and collage end on the hook's last frame.

The end of the old burned hook is measured to the frame, so the Hook Banner, the Hook Collage and the plate never run into the next scene.

The plate always reaches the export.

With a hook collage on, the Replace plate you see in the editor is now always in the rendered video.

Localization always gives you a video.

When a check after translating finds a problem, you still get the localized video, and the Captions note tells you what to look at.

Links import from any folder.

TikTok and Instagram links download again when Variator lives in a folder whose name has spaces or non-Latin letters.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.3 (2565) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2565)

Variator 0.4.1.3: the preview canvas works by hand - rotate with the mouse, scale with the corners, drag at any moment, pick the right layer - and renders no longer stop at start.

Rotate with the mouse.

The round handle turns the element on the canvas and in the export; undo, redo and autosave keep the angle.

Scale with the corners.

Corner handles scale tracked and small elements, near the edge too, and never rotate them by mistake.

The click picks what you see.

A click selects the visible top layer at the current moment, a rotated text by its shape, and a hidden logo shows no handles.

The collage hook shows its words.

With the hook collage on, Generate and Roll put the new words on the canvas; your position and style stay.

Renders start on every Mac.

A locked Homebrew OpenSSL setting can no longer stop renders, previews or downloads.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.3 (2554) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2554)

Variator 0.4.1.3 candidate: with the hook collage on, Generate and Roll put the new hook words on the canvas again.

The collage hook shows its new words.

With the hook collage on, the hook appears on the canvas as soon as you press Replace, and the generated words go into it. Your moves, size and style stay as you set them.

Renders no longer stop at start.

Variator's engine uses its own empty security setting, so a locked Homebrew OpenSSL file can no longer stop renders, previews or downloads.

What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2551)

Variator 0.4.1.3 candidate: the built-in engine starts on every Mac, even when a Homebrew OpenSSL setting cannot be read.

Renders no longer stop at start.

Variator's engine now uses its own empty security setting, so a locked Homebrew OpenSSL file on the Mac can no longer stop renders, previews or downloads.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.3 (2548) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2548)

Variator 0.4.1.3 candidate (canvas): rotating with the mouse turns the picture, scale arrows scale tracked objects, drag, handles and layer picking follow what is drawn, rotated text stays inside the frame.

Rotation turns the picture.

Turning an element with the round handle now rotates what you see and in the export, not only the saved angle.

Scale works on tracked objects.

Scaling a tracked object changes its drawn size; handles sit on the object and stay reachable at small sizes.

Click and drag pick the right layer.

A click selects the layer you see, rotated layers are picked by their shape, choosing in the list starts a fresh selection, and drag and scale presses have one owner.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.3 (2536) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2536)

Variator 0.4.1.3 candidate: hook and Suggest never write invented text and show the reason with Switch engine; batch keeps each video's own hook; the developer switch works in every build; erase failures report what stayed readable.

Your text stays.

When the text engine fails, Replace, Roll, Suggest and batch keep your text and show the reason with Switch engine; nothing invented is written.

Suggest shows what happens.

Suggest on a selected text shows progress and, if it fails, the same reason row as Hook; an old answer never overwrites newer text.

Developer switch works.

The hidden developer gesture works in every build again.

Erase failures explain themselves.

When erased text stays readable, the log names the frames, boxes and coverage.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.3 (2525) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2525)

Variator 0.4.1.3 candidate: canvas clicks, handles and rotated layers behave as drawn; subtitles match the export at cue edges, avoid burned text and group the same words; padded 16:9 text matches the export.

Click what you see.

A fresh click selects the top layer you see; a repeat click at the same point goes to the layer below. Choosing a layer in the list starts fresh. Rotated layers are clicked by their shape. Hidden tracked layers show no handles.

Subtitles match the video.

The paused preview shows a subtitle only while it is on screen in the export, ends it at the same frame, keeps a kept subtitle when an overlapping one is removed, and groups the same words as the export after a trim.

Subtitles avoid burned text.

Speech subtitles are placed clear of every burned caption and move when text is found late.

16:9 text stays where you put it.

On a 16:9 video in a 9:16 frame, text is drawn in the preview where the export draws it.

Long variable-frame-rate videos map fully.

Every frame of a long variable-frame-rate video is read, not only the first part.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.3 (2506) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.3 (Build 2506)

Variator 0.4.1.3 candidate: canvas clicks select what you see, scale arrows scale, late burned captions are found, Erase Region ignores texture noise, the hook Font row is back with TikTok Sans as default, plus the 2487 fixes.

Clicks select what you see.

A click on the preview selects the element shown at that moment; a hidden element no longer takes the click.

Scale arrows scale.

Pressing the corner arrows of a selected element scales it; rotation starts only from the round handle.

Late captions are found.

Burned captions anywhere in the video become editable layers, not only the first seconds.

Erase ignores texture noise.

Two or three letters read from clothing or background no longer fail an Erase Region export.

TikTok Sans by default; Font row in the Hook card.

Hook, banner and subtitles start in TikTok Sans; the Hook card Font row edits the same font as Fine-tune Hook.

Analyze finishes reliably.

On a busy Mac, Analyze sometimes failed with 'completed analysis event did not include artifactPath' after it had finished. The app now reads the whole result before it continues.

Text stays inside the frame.

A text block placed near an edge is moved inward so no letter is cut off, in the preview and in the export.

Videos with an odd width or height render.

A video such as 719x1280 now renders at the nearest even size instead of failing.

No microphone prompt.

Exporting no longer makes macOS ask for microphone access.

Phone videos with an uneven frame rate render on the Engine.

Clips that move between 24 and 30 frames per second keep the same picture as the preview.

Subtitles in the export match the preview.

Speech subtitles break into the same phrases in the preview and in the exported video.

Karaoke highlights the spoken word in every export.

The TikTok Karaoke style lights the current word also when the export uses the fallback renderer.

Studio Hard works on videos without a face.

A caption-only video renders without the spotlight instead of stopping with an error.

Local models keep to their own folder.

Model downloads no longer read or write your personal Hugging Face cache or token.

item.title: Version 0.4.1.2 (2457) QA
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.4.1.2 (Build 2457)

Variator 0.4.1.2 candidate: speech subtitles and your own fonts reach the export, HDR stays HDR, Thai hooks read correctly, 29.97, 60 fps and variable-frame-rate phone videos render on the Engine, and a crash during diagnostics upload is fixed.

Speech subtitles are in the export.

In Studio and Localization the subtitles you see in the preview are now burned into the exported video.

Your own fonts reach the export.

A font you dropped in or downloaded is used in the exported video, not only in the preview.

HDR stays HDR.

An HDR iPhone clip keeps its HDR colour in the preview and in the export.

Thai hook text is read in Thai.

A hook written in one non-Latin script is read in its own language; a mixed or unreadable hook shows a reason.

The Liliya recipe keeps the voice pitch.

The Standard UGC recipe no longer raises the voice pitch.

The banner names only your delivered variations.

A freshly imported video no longer shows a 'Derived Variation' banner from old test runs; the banner names only variations of the open video that you delivered.

Every export gets its own name.

Exports are named from their own result instead of a fixed placeholder, so repeated exports to one folder no longer collide as -2, -3, -4.

No developer controls in the release build.

A packaged build hides the DEV badge, Lab, Arcade and Dock Animation and is stamped as a candidate.

29.97 and 60 fps videos render like the preview.

Videos at 29.97, 23.976, 59.94 and 60 frames per second now go through the same renderer as the preview, so the export matches what you see.

Phone videos with an uneven frame rate keep their full length.

A video whose frame rate changes while recording no longer loses its last half second, and its picture stays in step with the sound.

No more quits after a diagnostics upload.

The app no longer closes during work shortly after it sends its diagnostics.

Your recipe choice stays when you apply a recipe.

Apply Recipe keeps the goal you picked instead of switching it back.
